# go-lisp (.lgo) files in modules from the module cache are built.

go mod tidy
go list -m example.com/golisp
stdout '^example.com/golisp v1.0.0$'
go list -f '{{.GoFiles}}' example.com/golisp/lisp example.com/golisp/mixed
stdout '^\[lisp.lgo\]$'
stdout '^\[mixed.lgo who.go\]$'

go run .
stdout '^hello, module cache$'

-- go.mod --
module example.com/main

go 1.28

require example.com/golisp v1.0.0
-- main.go --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"example.com/golisp/mixed"
)

func main() {
	fmt.Println(mixed.Message())
}
